fields.statement: Change set 'Fix Ship-change stops on a' (PR 383) can never land: it updated a node (rename, new statement), then retired it in a later entry. `rhiza retire` bases the retire on the node's landed version (Node.Version skips the change set's own ops), so at land model.checkBase sees the retire as stale against the change set's own earlier update and refuses (exit 3). rhiza check only warns (rule in-flight), so CI passed and the watchdog caught it at land. How should this change set fix it?
